}}{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Vegan cuisine|Vegan cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Sandwiches|Sandwiches]]
==Ingredients==
*2 slices of [[Cookbook:Bread|bread]] (preferably [[Cookbook:Organic|organic]] [[Cookbook:Wholemeal|wholemeal]] bread)
*Sliced [[Cookbook:Vegetable|vegetable]]s (e.g. [[Cookbook:Mushroom|mushroom]]s, [[Cookbook:Zucchini|courgettes]], [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]], [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|peppers]], etc.)
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:Olive oil|olive oil]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Oregano|oregano]]

==Procedure==
#Place bread slices next to each other on a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking tray]].
#Arrange the vegetables evenly across both slices.
#Drizzle the olive oil over the vegetables, and add liberal sprinklings of oregano.
#[[Cookbook:Broiling|Broil]] on medium-high heat for 5–10 minutes, or until golden brown.
#Serve open-faced, or carefully combine the two parts of the sandwich.
